info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Advertising Details API
info.description: The Advertising Details API provides access to detailed information about specific advertising campaigns within the marketing domain. By utilizing the advertising ID, users can retrieve comprehensive insights into individual campaigns, including performance metrics and targeting information. This API is particularly valuable for marketing professionals, data analysts, and campaign managers who need to evaluate and optimize advertising strategies. Businesses can leverage this data to make informed decisions and improve their overall marketing effectiveness.
